svg.title: AKS troubleshooting lab — Azure architecture view
svg.desc: Historical one-node AKS learning lab in East US. The lab resource group contains the AKS resource and Container Registry. The AKS-managed group contains a virtual network, Azure CNI node subnet, one VM scale set worker and OS disk, Standard load balancer for outbound connections and its static public IP. A separate local port-forward path connects the laptop through the Kubernetes API and worker kubelet to a selected API Pod. Infrastructure was removed November 1, 2026.

g.text: Azure architecture view · verified deployment on 1 November 2026
ACR Tasks builds the API image
api-service selects the Pod and maps port 80 to targetPort 8000; the authenticated tunnel connects to that Pod.
Custom lab diagram using Microsoft Azure architecture icons · Redrawn 3 November 2026
